name: Spectral
source:
Step into the eerie world of Spectral , a gripping adventure where foster brothers Sam Wesson and Dean Smith (From the TV Show, Supernatural) find themselves drawn to the infamous Vandertunt Mansion. The mysterious estate, steeped in dark legends and chilling ghost stories, becomes the centerpiece of their latest investigation. As the duo, you'll unravel cryptic clues, navigate ominous halls, and face malevolent spirits lurking in the shadows.

Your choices shape their journey—will they emerge victorious, or will the mansion claim them as its next victims? Spectral combines immersive storytelling, rich character dynamics, and pulse-pounding suspense, making every decision crucial. Dive deep into the lore, confront the unknown, and decide the brothers' fate in this unforgettable haunted house adventure.

[From [url=https://mystery-zone-games.itch.io/spectral]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
走进《Spectral》的怪异世界，这是一场扣人心弦的冒险，养兄弟萨姆·韦森和迪恩·史密斯（来自电视剧《超自然》）发现自己被臭名昭著的范德图特大厦所吸引。这座神秘的庄园充满了黑暗的传说和令人毛骨悚然的鬼故事，成为他们最新调查的核心。作为二人组，你们将解开神秘的线索，穿越不祥的大厅，并面对潜伏在阴影中的恶毒灵魂。

你的选择决定了他们的旅程——他们会取得胜利，还是豪宅会声称他们是下一个受害者？《Spectral》结合了身临其境的故事讲述、丰富的人物动态和扣人心弦的悬念，让每一个决定都至关重要。在这场令人难忘的鬼屋冒险中，深入了解传说，面对未知，并决定兄弟的命运。

[来自[url=https://mystery-zone-games.itch.io/spectral]Itch.io[/url]]
